raw_response: {"diagnosis":"The batch 14 re-delivery (ingest 05:00) re-sent the same 326 transactions with txn_ts as epoch milliseconds (e.g. 1768716104000 = 2026-01-18 06:01:44 UTC, matching the original row exactly). This breaks the TIMESTAMP cast and would also duplicate txn_ids, so silver must parse both formats and dedupe by txn_id.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.88,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH parsed AS (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN txn_ts ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, ingest_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'), dedup AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts ASC) AS rn FROM parsed) SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM dedup WHERE rn = 1;"}}
